ms.promise:
・(A) Back-end development: completion of the back-end development of the platform
・(B) Cardano blockchain: integration with Cardano node
・(C) News with the status of the proposal development on the Cardano Feed
ms.criteria:
・(A) The back-end development will be considered complete when all specified technical requirements are implemented, supporting all operations efficiently. There must be complete and error-free integration with the front-end, with successful integration tests confirming API functionality. Including complete features: DRep ID, Voting record, Cardano $ADA delegated + wallets, Ways to connect to DRep, Segments of expertise, Spoken languages, Search function to filter DReps as per the users preferences. DReps social platforms, blogs, Youtube and social medias
・(B) Integrating with the Cardano Bloc
ms.report:
